title: Meta Ads Auction Mechanics, Advantage+ & Creative Diversity
overview: Meta Ads delivers performance advertising across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and Audience Network using an automated auction model and machine-learning creative optimization.
coreConcepts: Total Value Auction Formula: Total Value = [Advertiser Bid] x [Estimated Action Rates] + [User Value]
Learning Phase requirement: 50 optimization events per ad set within 7 days
Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) combining prospecting and retargeting into a single machine-learning entity
Creative fatigue driven by frequency saturation and creative homogeneity
features: Advantage Campaign Budget (formerly CBO) dynamically shifting spend to top ad sets
Advantage+ Creative enhancements (automatic aspect ratio expansion, image brightness, 3D effects)
Meta Marketing API (v20.0) for programmatic campaign creation, budgeting, and automated rules
Flexible Ads format allowing combinations of up to 10 images/videos and 5 copy variants
bestPractices: Consolidate ad set structure: fewer broad ad sets perform better than fractured granular audiences
Deploy at least 3 distinct creative angles per ad set (User Generated Content, Founder Story, Product Feature, Social Proof)
Do not edit active ad sets with budget changes > 20% in a single day to avoid resetting the learning phase
Utilize 9:16 vertical video for Instagram Reels and Stories alongside 1:1 and 4:5 for Feed
policies: Meta Advertising Standards regarding misleading business practices and sensationalism
Mandatory Special Ad Categories for Credit, Employment, Housing, and Social Issues/Elections
Strict prohibitions on before/and after imagery in weight loss, health, and cosmetic procedures
limitations: Meta Graph API rate limiting tracked via X-Business-Use-Case headers (calls, CPU time, total time)
Maximum 250 active ad sets per ad account (depending on account tier)
Attribution window limited to 7-day click and 1-day view post-iOS 14.5
commonIssues: Ad sets stuck in 'Learning Limited' status due to fragmented budgets
Ad fatigue causing sharp CPA spikes after 14-21 days of delivery
High CPM spikes caused by severe audience overlap between competing ad sets

troubleshootingGuide.issue: High audience overlap between internal ad sets
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Use Audience Overlap Tool in Audiences tab; consolidate overlapping ad sets into a single broad audience

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Creative fatigue detected on top-spending ad
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Deploy new creative hook variants into the ad set and pause fatigued variants once new variants exit learning
